sources.title: briaai/Fibo-Edit-1.5-turbo · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Built on the FIBO editing paradigm, FIBO-Edit 1.5 Turbo is a faster, distilled variant of FIBO-Edit 1.5 Base, enabling precise, controllable edits with support for up to four reference images for more flexible and reliable editing.

sources.title: Fibo Edit - bria.ai
sources.snippet: The Impact FIBO Edit gives power back to the users, developers, and researchers. High controllability enables the user to predictably reproduce high quality edits, while researchers and developers are enabled to customize model weights to optimize the model for their specific need.
